21:45.text: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

21:46.text: a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

21:47.text: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is
the weight of a mustard seed,
We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

21:48.text: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder

21:49.text: while they are of the Hour apprehensive.

21:50.text: is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

21:51.text: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before,
and We were of him well-Knowing

21:52.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

21:53.text: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

21:54.text: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

21:55.text: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

21:56.text: , rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

21:57.text: by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
